channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.83 — macOS update
## macOS
- Optional **Apple Intelligence (on device)** for meeting summaries, note chat and dictation cleanup, each independently selectable in Settings. - Requires an eligible Mac with macOS 26 or later and Apple Intelligence enabled. Availability and model-download states are explained in the relevant settings page. Existing provider choices are not changed. - Streams responses locally without an API key or automatic cloud fallback. Long notes and meetings are processed in bounded sections with meeting progress and cancellation; originals remain recoverable. - Meeting titles reuse the completed summary. Oversized or failed dictation cleanup preserves the original text. Setup packages keep Apple selections Mac-only. - Updated German and English help. Source-based date instructions avoid guessing calendar dates from relative deadlines.
**Please note:** This optional system model is not a replacement for your existing engines. Long content can take several minutes and condensation can omit details; check names, dates and tasks against the original. Transcription and speaker separation are unchanged. This release was tested on macOS 26.5.2; macOS-27-specific roadmap features are separate work.
## Windows
No Windows binary in this release. [Windows 1.1.82](https://github.com/BIK-GmbH/desktop-recorder-releases/releases/tag/v1.1.82) remains current and available through the platform-aware in-app updater.
SHA256: - `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `afdc9917d37cfd4bcba02921acf80c31e93407babd08760655db95ea36938ccf`

# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.81 — macOS update
## macOS
- Schnellzugriffe sind jetzt als offene Liste in die Seitenleiste integriert: klare Überschrift, einheitliche Ausrichtung und kein verschachteltes Ausklappmenü. - Das Anpassen öffnet sich in einem großzügigen Fenster mit gut lesbarer Überschrift. Fertig, Enter oder Esc schließen es; Änderungen werden sofort übernommen. - Favoriten und ihre Reihenfolge bleiben erhalten. Eine eigene Notizen-Überschrift trennt die Bereiche. Die Mindesthöhe beträgt jetzt 520 Punkte, damit der erste Schnellzugriff vollständig sichtbar bleibt. - Hilfe auf Deutsch und Englisch aktualisiert.
This release contains macOS only. Windows quick-access parity follows after the Mac design review; Apple AI integration is a later stage.
SHA256: - DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg: faccd82ea901eda77c39f1ca2b4567135f5dd41c38d8be1606d4d979cec85877

# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.80 — macOS update
## macOS
- Personal quick access in the sidebar, with Dictation History ready to open in one click. - Add settings pages and app areas, reorder or remove favorites, and keep the selection across restarts. - The same favorites are available from the menu bar. Short windows use a compact first-favorite row with an overflow popover; the mini-recorder is unchanged. - Updated German and English help.
This release contains macOS only. Windows remains on its latest Windows release. The larger Apple AI, Knowledge Inbox and Knowledge Spaces work is not included in this release.
SHA256:
- `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `cb2a2697c09fecce2d3aa79b5471796d1a05c6a202d01b232af8f3bff92a7efa`
